result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, showToast(`${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`) — the template literal is always at least `": "`, so the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback in `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)` is unreachable dead code. Also err.message values like "booking_not_found"/"you_do_not_have_permission" are tRPC error codes, not translation keys added to the locale file in this diff, so t() renders the raw key. This is a verifiable, minor error-handling defect introduced by the diff, though low-impact.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` the `onError` handler builds `message` via a template literal: `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;`. A template literal always returns a non-empty string (at minimum it includes `": "`), so `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never hit the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback and may display confusing strings like `"undefined: <...>"` when `err.data?.code` is missing.
